card.name: Career and profession descriptions, just before job terms
card.fires_on: Words in career-guide style text about a profession (radiology technologists, veterinarians, athletic trainers, wandmakers). It fires on linking words or partway through job titles, where a word like profession or occupation could come next.

modes.label: Job-title words
modes.description: Inside or right after the name of a health profession such as radiologic technologist.
modes.example: Radiologic techn<<ologists>> also make sure that all equipment is ready

modes.label: Linking words in career text
modes.description: Small words like in, an, the, such, or me that come before a work or career term.
modes.example: veterinarians interested<< in>> working with federal and state animal health officials

card.writes: It suppresses words like professions, occupations and industries, so it makes those words less likely as the next word.
card.plain: It lights up in career-guide text about a job, at spots where a word like profession might otherwise follow.
